summary.text: Tom Hutchinson is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 37B who was elected in November 2022 and has served since January 11, 2023, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A health care industry executive and owner of Hutchinson Homes Services, LLC, he serves on the Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Tom Hutchinson was born in Cape May, New Jersey, on May 25, 1965, and earned a B.S. in computer science from Dickinson College in 1987 and an M.B.A. from Loyola University Maryland in 2002, according to his General Assembly biography.

He held vice president and managing director positions at several health care analytics and consulting firms from 1992 to 2020, including HCIA, The Jackson Organization, Quality Health Strategies and Alliance Franchise Brands, and has been president and owner of Hutchinson Homes Services, LLC since 2020.
He served on the Chesapeake College Foundation board and the Cambridge Main Street board of directors.
Hutchinson has served on the Health Committee since taking office in 2023 and in 2026 sits on the Maryland Health Insurance Coverage Protection Commission.
He chairs the Dorchester County Delegation, a post he has held since 2023, and the Talbot County Delegation in 2026.
Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
